displayName: OCI-AI-DB-002: AI — Vector Database Unauthorized Access
description:
Detects unauthorized access attempts to vector databases storing embeddings

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_db_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%vector%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%database%') AND "value" > 0
